Good — I have the full picture. Now I'll build all the components: the Bible reader page, floating selection toolbar, verse highlighting, notes panel, and note card — all in small reusable pieces.Now update `layout.tsx` to load Lora from Google Fonts:Now write all the primitive components in parallel:Now redirect the root page to `/bible`:Here is a full breakdown of everything built and the integration guidance:

---

## What was built

### Theme (`globals.css`)
Five semantic design tokens were added specifically for the Bible reader — `--verse-highlight`, `--verse-highlight-border`, `--note-stripe`, `--toolbar-bg`, and `--toolbar-fg` — all on a warm parchment base palette (oklch amber/chestnut). Lora serif is now the primary font.

### Components (`/components/bible/`)

| File | Purpose | Key classes |
|---|---|---|
| `verse-block.tsx` | Single verse with highlight, selection, note-dot states | `bg-verse-highlight border-l-[3px] border-verse-highlight-border` for highlights; `ring-1 ring-primary/30` for active selection drag |
| `selection-toolbar.tsx` | Dark floating pill with Highlight / Add Note / Cancel | `absolute z-50 -translate-x-1/2 bg-toolbar-bg text-toolbar-fg rounded-lg shadow-xl` + a pure-CSS downward caret via border-trick |
| `note-card.tsx` | Panel note entry with verse badge, text preview, edit/delete | `border-l-[3px] border-note-stripe` accent stripe; actions appear on `group-hover` / `group-focus-within` |
| `notes-panel.tsx` | Right-side panel + empty state | `w-full md:w-72 xl:w-80 shrink-0 md:sticky md:top-14`; stacks below on mobile when `open={false}` |
| `note-editor.tsx` | Centered modal for create/edit | Backdrop blur scrim + `role="dialog" aria-modal` + Escape-to-close |

### Hook (`/hooks/use-bible-selection.ts`)
`useBibleSelection()` tracks `window.getSelection()`, maps which `[data-verse]` elements are inside the range, and returns `toolbarPos` (document-relative `{ top, left }`) ready to pass straight into `<SelectionToolbar position={...} />`.

### Integration pattern
Attach `onMouseUp={onContainerMouseUp}` to the reading `<main>` element. Add `data-verse={number}` to every `<VerseBlock>` (already wired). The toolbar, highlights, note dots, and panel all react to the same shared state in `BiblePage`. Swap in your real data source by replacing the `VERSES` and `INITIAL_NOTES` arrays.

messages.content: Design UI updates for the Next.js (app router) Bible reader page (/bible) using Tailwind only, preserving the existing visual language. We need multi-verse text selection highlights with a compact floating toolbar near the selection (actions: Highlight, Add Note, Cancel), plus a right-side notes panel that lists notes for the current chapter with selected-text previews and edit/delete actions. Keep components small and reusable. Include mobile behavior (panel stacks below on small screens). No new libraries. Provide class names and component structure ideas we can integrate into existing components.
